summary: Approximately 118,484 km² and about 17.6 million people (2018), from Wikidata's Q1020 (P2046, P1082). The English Wikipedia article "Malawi", at revision 1375540264, opens: "Malawi, officially the Republic of Malawi, is a landlocked country in Southeast Africa. It is bordered by Zambia to the west, Tanzania to the north and northeast, and Mozambique to the east, south, and southwest. Malawi spans over 118,484 km2 (45,747 sq mi) and has a population of 22,224,282." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Entity 553 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 1 period of territorial validity, from 1964 to where the dataset stops, in 2019. Its last capital in the dataset is Lilongwe. The code is mapped onto more than one actor (data/imports/cshapes-actors.json); this record holds the periods from 1964-07-06. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
